difficulty_why: Requires a dedicated developer sandbox account to access the Developer Hub. Once configured as a private app and toggled to live, any customer can connect immediately without marketplace review.

dev_time.label: 15-30 min
dev_time.text: Time required to create a free developer sandbox, access Developer Hub, register a private app, configure scopes, and obtain OAuth credentials.

launch_time.label: Same day
launch_time.text: Private apps switched to Live status can connect any external customer account immediately via OAuth with zero review wait time.

own_app_reasons.label: Custom branding on consent screen
own_app_reasons.text: Displays your own app name, logo, and brand to customers during the OAuth authorization consent screen.

own_app_reasons.label: Configurable permission scopes
own_app_reasons.text: Allows you to customize and extend OAuth access scopes beyond Composio defaults to match your specific agent needs.

app_type.label: Private App
app_type.text: Create a Private App in Developer Hub. Private apps provide OAuth 2.0 client credentials and can connect external customer accounts directly without Marketplace submission or review.

prerequisites.label: Free Developer Sandbox Account
prerequisites.text: A free Pipedrive developer sandbox account is required to access Developer Hub and create apps (includes 5 test seats).

prerequisites.label: Sandbox activity policy
prerequisites.text: Sandbox accounts require an app to be created within 45 days and made live or submitted within 6 months to prevent deletion.

prerequisites.label: App type permanence
prerequisites.text: App type selection (Private vs Public) is final in Developer Hub and cannot be edited after creation.

steps.label: Register Developer Sandbox
steps.text: Sign up for a free developer sandbox account on the Pipedrive developer portal homepage.

steps.label: Open Developer Hub
steps.text: Log in to your sandbox account, click your profile icon in the top right corner, switch to your sandbox company, and open Developer Hub.

steps.label: Create Private App
steps.text: Click 'Create an app' and select 'Create private app' from the dropdown options.

steps.label: Configure Basic Info
steps.text: Enter your App name and set the Callback URL to the Composio redirect URI, then click Save.

steps.label: Configure OAuth Scopes
steps.text: Navigate to the 'OAuth & access scopes' tab, select full access scopes for contacts, leads, mail, activities, products, and projects, and click Save.

fields.label: Access scopes
fields.value: contacts:full, leads:full, mail:full, activities:full, products:full, projects:full

steps.label: Copy OAuth Credentials
steps.text: Copy your Client ID and Client Secret from the 'OAuth & access scopes' tab to add into Composio.

steps.label: Change Status to Live
steps.text: Click 'Change to live' on your private app so any external Pipedrive customer can authorize through the OAuth flow.

scopes.label: contacts:full
scopes.text: Full access to view, add, edit, and delete contacts, persons, and organizations; no restricted scope review required.

scopes.label: leads:full
scopes.text: Full access to view, add, edit, and delete sales leads; no restricted review required.

scopes.label: mail:full
scopes.text: Full access to view, edit, and delete email messages and mail threads; no restricted review or external audit required.

scopes.label: activities:full
scopes.text: Full access to view, add, edit, and delete calendar activities; no restricted review required.

scopes.label: products:full
scopes.text: Full access to view, add, edit, and delete catalog products; no restricted review required.

scopes.label: projects:full
scopes.text: Full access to view, add, edit, and delete project items; no restricted review required.

approval.label: When required
approval.text: Marketplace review is only required if listing publicly in the Pipedrive Marketplace; private apps require no submission or review and can be shared directly with any customer company via an authorization URL.

approval.label: What's checked
approval.text: Public reviews inspect OAuth 2.0 flow handling, token refresh logic, minimal scope usage, rate limit compliance, pricing transparency, and customer support responsiveness.

approval.label: Wait
approval.text: Public Marketplace app review takes up to 21 business days.

approval.label: Cost
approval.text: Developer sandbox accounts and app reviews are completely free with no submission fees.

approval.label: Common rejections
approval.text: Requesting unnecessary scopes, failing to refresh 60-minute expired tokens, broken installation/uninstall callbacks, and missing support information.

approval.label: Before approval
approval.text: In Draft status, testing is restricted to sandbox users; toggle app status to Live to allow any external customer company to connect.

approval.label: Install cap before review
approval.text: No install cap. Live private apps can be installed across unlimited customer accounts via direct OAuth authorization.

approval.label: Limits until reviewed
approval.text: No reduced limits apply. Unreviewed and private apps operate under standard plan-based token budgets and OAuth burst limits (80 to 480 requests per 2 seconds).

pitfalls.label: Access tokens expire in 60 minutes
pitfalls.text: OAuth access tokens expire after 3600 seconds (1 hour); clients must continuously refresh tokens using the refresh token.

pitfalls.label: Refresh token expires if unused for 60 days
pitfalls.text: Refresh tokens expire if left inactive for 60 days, requiring the user to re-authorize through the OAuth flow.

pitfalls.label: Permanent app type selection
pitfalls.text: App type (Private vs Public) is locked upon creation and cannot be changed later; switching requires creating a new app.

pitfalls.label: Single callback URL allowed
pitfalls.text: Pipedrive allows only one callback URL per app; the redirect URI in requests must match it character-for-character.

pitfalls.label: Per-user authorization requirement
pitfalls.text: Pipedrive apps authorize per-user rather than tenant-wide; individual users within a company account must authorize separately.

pitfalls.label: Sandbox deletion after 45 days of inactivity
pitfalls.text: Sandbox accounts are automatically deleted if no app is created within 45 days or made live within 6 months.

support.text: Direct Marketplace and API developer support email: marketplace.devs@pipedrive.com.

support.label: Developer Documentation
support.text: Official Pipedrive API reference and Marketplace developer guide.

email_subject: Pipedrive OAuth Integration Query - Private App Scopes and Distribution
email_body:
Hi Pipedrive Developer Support Team,

We are developing an AI agent platform that connects to Pipedrive on behalf of our mutual customers using OAuth 2.0 via Composio.

We plan to use a private app switched to "Live" status so our enterprise customers can authorize their own Pipedrive accounts directly using our OAuth client credentials. We intend to request the following scopes:
- contacts:full
- leads:full
- mail:full
- activities:full
- products:full
- projects:full

Could you please confirm:
1. Are there any restrictions, user caps, or tenant limits when connecting external customer companies via a live private OAuth app?
2. Do any of the requested scopes require security reviews or marketplace listing approval if the app remains private?
3. Are standard API token and burst rate limits applied per company account or per OAuth client?

Developer details:
- Name: [Your Name]
- Company: [Your Company]
- App Name: [Your App Name]
- Contact Email: [Your Email]

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Title]

checks.label: Composio toolkit
checks.text: Composio has a toolkit for Pipedrive (`pipedrive`); Composio-managed OAuth app: no; auth methods: OAUTH2, API_KEY

checks.label: Authorize URL
checks.text: Authorize URL is live and rejects an unregistered client_id, so you need a real registered app

observed.label: Developer signup is self-serve
observed.text: Developer registration is self-serve via the developer sandbox signup form directly on the developer homepage, requiring no sales contact.

observed.label: Sandbox signup form fields
observed.text: The sandbox registration form requires First Name, E-mail, and agreement to Terms of Service, Developer Agreement, and Privacy Notice.

observed.label: No credit card required
observed.text: No credit card, billing details, or paid plan selection fields are present during developer sandbox registration.

observed.label: App creation entry point
observed.text: OAuth app creation begins inside the Developer Hub in the developer sandbox account via a 'Create an app' button.
